GOS.Dialog.NothingToImport: No files were found for this type.
GOS.Notify.NoToken: No GitHub token configured. Enter one in the module settings.
GOS.Notify.BadRepo: Invalid GitHub repository. Use the form "owner/repo" in the module settings.
GOS.Settings.SyncMode.Name: Sync mode
GOS.Settings.SyncMode.Hint: Choose how objects are synced: via a Git folder on the server, or directly with GitHub from the Foundry UI.
GOS.Settings.SyncAssets.Name: Sync assets (images/maps)
GOS.Settings.SyncAssets.Hint: Also sync referenced images, maps and audio so objects can be exported and imported completely.
GOS.Settings.ExportPath.Name: Git export folder
GOS.Settings.ExportPath.Hint: Path inside the Foundry Data directory where files are written (server mode). This folder should be a Git repository on the server.
GOS.Settings.GithubRepo.Name: GitHub repository
GOS.Settings.GithubRepo.Hint: For GitHub mode: the target repository as "owner/repo" (e.g. DominikGursch/foundry-content).
GOS.Settings.GithubBranch.Name: GitHub branch
GOS.Settings.GithubBranch.Hint: For GitHub mode: the branch to read from and write to (default: main).
GOS.Settings.GithubToken.Name: GitHub token
GOS.Settings.GithubToken.Hint: For GitHub mode: a fine-grained Personal Access Token with Contents read/write for the repository. Stored in the world settings; only the GM can see it.
GOS.Settings.OverwriteImport.Name: Overwrite on import
GOS.Settings.OverwriteImport.Hint: When an object with the same ID already exists, update it on import instead of creating a duplicate.
